adHocDeferred.reason: The official pages confirm Direct Payment at Stadtwerk am See charging points but publish neither a universal ad-hoc price nor precise payment methods. Do not infer the MEIN AUTO STROM contract tariff.

roamingPolicy.reason: The official FAQ limits GRÜNE KARTE with MEIN AUTO STROM to charging points operated by Stadtwerk am See. Never attach these prices to third-party physical CPO sites.

networkEvidence.policy: Attach the four MEIN AUTO STROM offers only to physical STADTWERK MOBILITY PLUS sites. Re-audit if a site outside Baden-Württemberg appears.

deferred.blockingFee: The current tariff, terms and ancillary-fee sheet publish no blocking or idle fee. No such fee is fabricated.
deferred.conditionalAdministrativeFees: The ancillary-fee sheet effective 2025-03-01 lists dunning, collection, EMAID reactivation and actual bank-return costs. These conditional debt or account-administration charges are not normal charging-session components and are excluded.

note: Current official MEIN AUTO STROM tariff checked 2026-09-01 and still displayed as effective since 2022-12-01. AC costs 0.49 EUR/kWh and DC 0.59 EUR/kWh at all charging points operated by Stadtwerk am See. The 1.95 EUR monthly base price and mandatory GRÜNE KARTE access cost are represented separately for energy customers and non-customers. The official 2025 transfer moved the physical charging infrastructure to STADTWERK MOBILITY PLUS without changing existing MEIN AUTO STROM contracts or prices.
